name.zh: 夜间 N2O5 吸收与 ClNO2（沿海）

summary.en: A polluted coastal air mass from 18:00 to 06:00: sea salt, ammonium sulfate-nitrate and organic-coated particles take up N2O5 (produced at 1 ppb/h) online; the products HNO3 and ClNO2 change nitrate and chloride. The ClNO2 yield depends on which particles carry chloride and water, i.e. on the mixing state.
summary.zh: 18:00 至次日 06:00 的沿海污染气团：海盐、硫酸铵-硝酸铵与有机包覆颗粒在线吸收 N2O5（生成速率 1 ppb/h），产物 HNO3 与 ClNO2 改变硝酸盐与氯。ClNO2 产率取决于哪些颗粒携带氯与水，即取决于混合态。

notes: N2O5 production 1 ppb/h (NO3 + NO2) with steady state [N2O5] = P / (k_het + k_other), k_other = 2e-3 1/s for the other NO3/N2O5 losses; k_het as CAM hetrxtrate on the current particles (CESM gamma 0.1 on the f_chm surface by default; switch to the species gamma table in Setup).
Products per N2O5: (2 - phi) HNO3 to the gas phase, phi ClNO2 with particle chloride; phi = 1/(1 + [H2O]/(483 [Cl-])) per section (Bertram & Thornton 2009).

case.reference: Bertram and Thornton (2009) ACP; Riemer et al. (2009) JGR (N2O5 and mixing state)
case.name: Nocturnal N2O5 uptake and ClNO2 (coastal)
